Что делает фильтр безопасности с опасной: What does a safety filter do with an unsafe policy command?
Заменяет её самой безопасной: останавлив: Replace it with the safest action: stop Ada
Берёт ближайшую к ней скорость, при кото: Take the nearest velocity for which the margin shrinks no faster than α·h, changing only approach toward the obstacle
Это задача CBF-QP: наименьшая поправка к: This is a CBF-QP: the smallest correction to the command. Thus, “straight into the kettle” becomes slow approach rather than a detour. With a 15 cm margin and α = 2, the filter kept 30 cm/s in the same direction.

Щит и фильтр с функцией барьера — одно и: Are a shield and a barrier-function filter the same thing?
Да, это два названия одного метода: Yes, they are two names for one method
Идея одна — менять команду политики как: They share the idea of changing the policy command as little as possible, but a shield works with discrete actions and is synthesized in advance from a specification, while a CBF filter solves a small optimization problem for a continuous command
Нет: щит нужен только во время обучения: No: a shield is needed only during training
Щит до агента убирает опасные действия,: A preemptive shield removes unsafe actions; a post-posed shield replaces an unsafe action with a safe one. Alshiekh and coauthors note that if unsafe actions are only penalized during training, the shield must remain active after training.
